items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall (quad) is not expected to play today vs Raiders. Braelon Allen is slated to start again and has averaged nearly 5 YPC with two 100-yard games as starter.
items.why: Still dealing with quad injury; limited practice, cryptic reports.
items.implication: Allen becomes lead back and solid RB2/flex with full workload potential.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown ruled OUT (knee/ankle) for Week 8 vs Dolphins along with RB TreVeyon Henderson (illness).
items.implication: Patriots pass catchers thin; look to remaining WRs/TEs for volume spikes.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for remaining NE skill players.

items.text: Expected to play: Jadarian Price/Zach Charbonnet, George Pickens, Jaylen Waddle, Colston Loveland, Jakobi Meyers, Kenny Gainwell, Calvin Ridley, Treylon Burks. OUT: AJ Brown, TreVeyon Henderson, others.
items.why: Weekend reports compilation; updated Hall not expected.
items.implication: Clear actives for lineup locks; outs create voids.

items.text: With Breece Hall not expected, Braelon Allen rides again as a solid RB2.
items.why: Hall out; Allen proven as starter with efficiency.
items.implication: Start Allen confidently in most formats.

items.text: Bills WR D.J. Moore (shoulder), who missed past two games, is expected to play today vs Ravens.
items.why: Recovered enough after limited practices post-bye.
items.implication: Adds weapon for Josh Allen; boosts BUF passing volume options.
items.opportunity: Targets/routes return; monitor snap share vs Kincaid status.

items.text: Colts open to dealing star RB Jonathan Taylor; active discussions. Would seek CMC-like haul (2nd/3rd/4th/5th).
items.implication: ROS uncertainty; hold or sell high depending on landing spot.
items.opportunity: Immediate role secure but monitor deadline.

items.text: Eagles will not trade Saquon Barkley before deadline; sources end speculation. Levitan notes shocked he wasn't on final IR (hamstring/back) but he's playing, though likely not 100%.
items.why: Team exploring other options; Barkley cleared report surprisingly.
items.implication: Start with caution on efficiency; no trade risk short-term.
items.opportunity: Full snaps expected but monitor workload/health.
items.conflict: Berry had as HATE previously on efficiency concerns.

items.text: Broncos WR Jaylen Waddle (chest), listed questionable, is trending toward playing vs Chiefs. Also expected per ETR.
items.why: Chest injury aggravated last week but positive reports.
items.implication: Keeps DEN WR corps intact opposite potential Harvey absence fallout.

items.text: Cowboys WR George Pickens, listed questionable, is expected to play vs Cardinals.
items.implication: Maintains DAL WR1 role and target share.

items.text: Broncos officially placed RB R.J. Harvey on short-term IR after knee injury in Thursday practice; out at least 4 games.
items.implication: Unique role leaves no clean handcuff; 3-6 targets free up in DEN offense.
items.opportunity: Pass-catching/receiving work redistributes; Waddle or others benefit.

items.text: Seahawks RBs Jadarian Price and Zach Charbonnet have no injury designations and both expected to play vs Bears (Charbonnet season debut).
items.implication: Backfield committee or split; both viable but risky flex due to unknown shares.
items.opportunity: Carries/snaps available in SEA run game.

items.text: DK parlay leans: Tee Higgins (more targets than Chase lately; TEN soft perimeter), Parker Washington (slot vs Colts), Dallas Goedert (WSH brutal vs TE; 20% share w/o Smith/Wicks).
items.opportunity: Higgins targets up; Goedert TE volume; Washington slot work.

items.text: RJ Harvey knee role unique with no clean handcuff; 3-6 more targets now free. Waddle Q compounds. Projections updated.
items.implication: DEN pass catchers (Waddle et al) see target bump.
items.opportunity: 3-6 extra targets available weekly while out.

items.text: Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle) weird practice (LP-LP-DNP out of bye); with BTJ situation, perhaps season-high routes for Travis Hunter. Meyers now expected to play.
items.implication: Hunter routes could spike if Meyers limited.

items.text: Lamar Jackson (ankle) not on final report (IN) but smallish docks on his rushing projections.
items.why: Ankle recovery limits rush volume somewhat.
items.implication: Still elite but slightly tempered rushing upside vs Bills.

items.text: Zay Flowers LOVE (WR5) with Lamar unlock; high target rate historically with Jackson back.
items.why: Lamar return unlocks; 48% target rate on routes prior.
items.implication: WR1 upside in track-meet vs Bills.

items.text: Derrick Henry LOVE (RB6) @ BUF in potential shootout.
Saquon Barkley HATE (RB20) despite IN; efficiency/health concerns @ WSH.
items.implication: Fade or lower expectations vs full health.
items.conflict: Levitan notes surprising full clear but not 100%.
